messages.content: First use the web search tool once for "IANA example domains". Then use the web fetch tool on exactly these two URLs, as two separate tool calls: https://httpbin.org/anything?n=1 and https://httpbin.org/anything?n=2 . For each one, quote exactly the value of the "origin" field and of the "User-Agent" header shown in the page. End with a line: REPORT searches=<n> fetches=<n>.
